2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 281(C) of 2022
for the offence under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and sect
ion 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. It is a case of matrimonial dispute between the parties.
Petitioner is the husband of opposite party no. 2 (complainant).
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is quite innocent, committed no offence and has been falsely implicated in this case.

5. During course of argument learned counsel for both Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66762 of 2024(4) dt.07-04-2025 the parties submits that earlier this case was referred to Mediation Centre,
Patna High Court, Patna where the matter has been amicably settled between the parties on the point of one time settlement.
Both the parties are agreed on the terms and conditions mentioned in the Memorandum of Agreement of Mediation Proceeding No. 20 of 2025.
